card.name: Digits inside numeric ranges and counts
card.fires_on: Digits or the word 'to' inside a number range or fraction in lab results, such as '86 to 115 mcg/mL' or '(11/115)'. It also fires weakly on 'see' or 'easy' just before 'why'.

modes.label: Numbers in ranges
modes.description: Digits or 'to' within a from-to value range or a count fraction in trial results.

modes.label: Before 'why'
modes.description: Words like 'see' or 'easy' in the phrase 'easy to see why'.

card.writes: It suppresses odd unrelated tokens and promotes 'why' in several languages, so the output effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on digits within numeric ranges and counts in study results, and on 'easy to see' just before 'why'.
